data.name: Darcnia Monster
data.detailed_description:
Place a card on the ground and its monster steps out of it. Darcnia is a free online tactical card game where every duel unfolds on a full-3D board and every card is a living pixel-art soul.

FREE, AND NO PAY TO WIN


Darcnia is free to play and won by playing. No card, no rank and no advantage is ever sold for money. Paying doesn't take you further — only faster.


  • Every card is earned by playing. Duels, quests and floors of the Tower: every card in the game is within reach of your deck without spending a cent.

  • No gacha. No paid packs, no real-money rolls. You always know exactly which card you're chasing and how far you are from it.

  • No paywalled exclusives. What money buys is presentation and convenience, never power.

COLLECT, TRADE AND BID


Your cards are truly yours. Every copy has its own printing, art and shine — and all of them can move between players:


  • Trading — build the swap card by card, both showcases in view, confirmed by both sides.

  • Auctions — put a copy up in the auction house and let the rest of Darcnia fight over it.

  • Friends and live rooms — friend list, chat and notifications to close the deal while it's hot.

CLIMB THE TOWER


Ten floors above the void. Ten keepers waiting. Defeat them and seal them — every victory becomes a card in your deck. A story told in cards, floor by floor, guided by a mage who remembers too much.

ONLINE DUELS


Take your deck against other players in ranked and friendly matches, or drill against the AI when you want to test an idea. Same engine, same 3D board, same rules.

MASTER THE RUNES


No spells. No traps. In Darcnia, magic is carved. Five kinds of runes shape every duel:


  • Spell Rune — instant effect: resolves once, then it is spent.

  • Power Rune — attaches to one of your monsters and boosts it.

  • Latent Rune — set face-down; springs as a surprise on your rival's move.

  • Domain Rune — stays in play and changes the rules of the whole field.

  • Rite Rune — the key to ritual summons: calls monsters too strong to simply play.

EVERY CARD IS A PIECE OF ART


Full-art frames, rank gems from F to SSS, and 100+ monsters to seal — painted pixel by pixel, with more on the way.

MADE BY ONE PERSON


Every card, every sprite and every rune drawn with intent. Wishlist Darcnia and join the ascent.

English*, Spanish - Latin America*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible, 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz
  • Graphics: dedicated GPU, 2 GB VRAM, OpenGL 3.3+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
